transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I suppose... well, I was told I should come in. It’s just some trouble at work. I supervise at a store, and... lately, when I try to explain the inventory numbers, or the weekend schedule, things just get... mixed up. 

My words start jumping around. I'll be talking about the delivery trucks, and then Thursdays, and then... I don't know, the church grill, or my boss’s tone of voice. People just look at me. Like they can’t follow what I’m saying at all. So... that's why I'm here.
Do you actually get stuck repeating or prolonging sounds or syllables when you speak?
No... I don't think so. It's not a stutter. It's just... the topics. Not the sounds themselves.
When you are speaking, do you feel like your thoughts are racing ahead and jumping from one idea to another, or is it mainly that you know what you want to say but the words come out jumbled?

I don't... I don't really know how to describe it. It's not racing, exactly. It's just... I try to explain something, and the words just... they don't line up right. I know what I want to say, but it comes out wrong.
Do you ever hear or see things that other people don’t?
No... I don't think so. I haven't noticed anything like that. It's really just the... the trouble talking. That's all.
Have you had this kind of trouble putting words together since you were a child?
No... not that I remember. I didn't have this problem back then.
Have you been feeling unusually suspicious that other people are trying to harm you, watch you, or control you?
No... no, I haven't. I just go to work and come home. I don't... I don't feel like anyone is watching me or anything.
Have you had any weakness, numbness, facial drooping, or trouble using one side of your body?
No... nothing like that. My body works fine. I haven't noticed any... any weakness or numbness.
Have you ever had episodes where you lost time or couldn’t remember what you had been doing?
No... I don't think so. I remember what I do during the day. I haven't... I haven't lost any time.
Have you had any recent head injury or other medical illness before this started?
No... no head injury. I haven't been sick either. Just... normal. Nothing like that happened.
After you finish speaking, do you realize that what came out was not making sense?
No... I don't... I don't think I do that. What I say makes sense to me. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do you ever believe things that other people would say are very strange or impossible, but you feel completely sure are true?
No... I don't think so. I just... believe normal things. I don't really talk to other people about what I think anyway, so... no. Nothing impossible.
